I'm mapping out the grid components near the virus, tracing which cells of 4s and 8s connect into distinct shapes at their respective positions.

Checking the virus at (4,5): its direct neighbors are all empty, but a knight-style jump over an empty cell reaches (4,7), which belongs to component C, so C gets infected. I'm now tracing further jump possibilities outward from C's cells to see what else might get pulled in.

After checking all the jump options from C's cells (1,8), (2,8), (3,7), (3,8), (4,7), none of them reach another shape—everything lands on empty cells. So it looks like C is the only component the virus infects this round.
